page_title: LEN 1-1 LIL | Lens v Lille 08/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+6' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post.
90+4' Facundo Medina (Lens) commits a foul during an attacking move.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Benoit Millot shows a yellow card to Leny Yoro (Lille) for his blatant foul.
88' Paulo Fonseca has decided to substitute Jonathan David and he is replaced by Yusuf Yazici (Lille).
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) replaces Angel Gomes.
87' A corner kick by Lille is thwarted by the well prepared Brice Samba (Lens).
87' Jonathan David (Lille) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. Lille force a corner. They send men into the box.
85' Lens take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
84' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Lens will take a corner.
82' What was Elye Wahi (Lens) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
82' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Angel Gomes (Lille) was quite harsh and Benoit Millot didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
80' Looks like Elye Wahi (Lens) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
79' The resulting set piece from Lens is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
79' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lens are going to take it.
77' Substitution. Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) on for Angelo Fulgini.
74' Elye Wahi (Lens) is flagged for offside.

74' Benjamin Andre (Lille) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and floats high over the bar.
70' 1 - 1 Deiver Machado (Lens) leaps to connect with a lovely cross and scores with a header that bounces off the ground and goes inside the left post. The goalkeeper had no chance to make a save.
69' Franck Haise has decided to make a change. Deiver Machado (Lens) replaces Abdukodir Khusanov.
69' Substitution. Ivan Cavaleiro makes way for Adam Ounas (Lille).
68' Alexsandro (Lille) picks up a caution.
68' Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) has a sight of goal and shoots goalwards, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
67' Jonathan David (Lille) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
65' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) swings in a cross from the corner, but Lucas Chevalier reads it well and gathers the ball.
65' Elye Wahi (Lens) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The linesman makes the right call and Lens will have a corner.
65' Lille enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
62' It's time for a substitution. Elye Wahi (Lens) comes on in place of Wesley Said.
62' Franck Haise has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) replacing Florian Sotoca.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andy Diouf trots off the pitch and is replaced by Adrien Thomasson (Lens).
59' Remy Cabella (Lille) plays a through ball but overhits it.
56' Franck Haise (Lens) gets a yellow card, off the field.
54' Lens failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
54' Wesley Said (Lens) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. The ball is out of play and Lens manage to earn a corner.
51' Remy Cabella (Lille) misses an absolute sitter after connecting with a cross inside the penalty box.
50' Salis Abdul Samed (Lens) was too forceful with his tackle and Benoit Millot interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
47' A decent cross gives Salis Abdul Samed (Lens) a chance to score, but he sends his header inches over the bar from close range.
47' The corner from Remy Cabella (Lille) is hurriedly cleared.
46' Benjamin Andre (Lille) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Lille earn a corner.
46' The second half has just started.
45+7' Benoit Millot has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+6' Remy Cabella (Lille) works the corner short.
45+6' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Corner kick. Lille will have an opportunity.
45+3' Remy Cabella (Lille) takes a short corner kick.
45+3' Bafode Diakite (Lille) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lille.
45+2' 0 - 1 Benjamin Andre (Lille) heads the ball into the middle after a splendid cross. This timely header produces a wonderful moment.
45+2' Remy Cabella (Lille) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) serves up a nice cross, but Lucas Chevalier punches the ball away.
42' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) sends the corner into the box, but Lucas Chevalier intercepts it and averts the threat.
42' Florian Sotoca (Lens) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The ball goes out for a corner. Lens can continue in their attacking effort.
39' Benjamin Andre (Lille) commits a rough foul. Benoit Millot stops the game and makes a call.
37' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
36' Andy Diouf (Lens) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Lens have been awarded a corner kick.
36' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
34' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lille.
32' NO PENALTY after a VAR review! The Lens players are visibly unhappy with the call.
31' Referee Benoit Millot makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Lens. Let’s see what happens!
31' Alexsandro (Lille) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
30' 6:1 – the total goal attempt statistics.
28' Great teamplay by Lens as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
26' Florian Sotoca (Lens) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Benoit Millot saw the whole situation.

23' Florian Sotoca (Lens) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom right corner, but Lucas Chevalier thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
23' Florian Sotoca (Lens) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
23' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) is about to take a corner kick.
22' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Wesley Said (Lens). The ball goes out of play. Lens are awarded a corner kick.
21' The resulting free kick from Angelo Fulgini (Lens) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
20' The game has begun to heat up. Ivan Cavaleiro (Lille) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
18' Close effort! Edon Zhegrova (Lille) takes the resulting free kick from a promising distance, but he sends it narrowly wide of the right post.
17' Facundo Medina (Lens) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benoit Millot had an easy-decision to make.
16' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lens.

16' Wesley Said (Lens) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Lucas Chevalier shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net. Lens get a corner.
13' Angel Gomes (Lille) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
12' Angel Gomes (Lille) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
9' The linesman raises his flag. Wesley Said (Lens) is adjudged offside.
9' Jonathan David (Lille) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
7' Jonathan David (Lille) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
4' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
3' A long pass, executed by Abdukodir Khusanov (Lens), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Lens will kick the game off.
Benoit Millot will referee today's match.
